Selected Case Studies

Objective

  • Drive growth through high-quality First-Time Deposits (FTDs). 

  • Ensure daily acquisition targets while maintaining high-value deposit averages.

​​

​Solution

  • Targeted Audience Segmentation: Identified sports enthusiasts likely to convert into FTDs.

  • AI-Powered Creative Optimization: Created dynamic, engaging ads tailored to user preferences, including both video and display formats.

  • Real-Time Campaign Management: Optimized bidding, placements, and creatives to ensure maximum ROI.

​​

Results

  • FTD Growth: Delivered 50+ new First-Time Deposits daily.

  • High-Value Users: Achieved an average deposit value of $800+ per user.

  • Client Success: Exceeded all client KPIs, driving sustained growth and high user engagement.

Objective

  • Acquire qualified users seeking to build credit safely and responsibly.

  • Ensure cost-efficient acquisition while achieving performance goals across platforms.

​​

​Solution

  • Audience Segmentation: Targeted individuals interested in personal finance and credit improvement.

  • AI-Driven Creative Automation: Produced dynamic, personalized ads highlighting Kikoff’s credit-building benefits.

  • CTV Success: Integrated Connected TV ads with performance campaigns, boosting reach and driving quality traffic.

  • Real-Time Optimization: Continuously refined bidding, targeting, and creative strategies to ensure consistent performance.

​​

Results

  • Qualified User Growth: Delivered 60 new qualified users daily.

  • Cross-Platform Success: Achieved top performance on TikTok, Meta, and CTV, surpassing client expectations.

  • Cost Efficiency: Exceeded CPA targets with a scalable, performance-driven model.

  • Client Success: Enhanced Kikoff’s brand visibility while driving consistent, high-quality user acquisition.

Objective

  •  Acquire high-value subscribers purchasing annual packages for Lightricks’ creative apps.

  • Focus on the U.S. market with a cost-efficient, performance-driven approach.

​​

​Solution

  • Advanced Targeting: Identified creative professionals and enthusiasts likely to subscribe to Facetune, Videoleap, and Photoleap.

  • AI-Powered Creative Automation: Designed engaging video and display ads showcasing the apps’ unique features, tailored for each platform.

  • Cross-Platform Strategy: Executed campaigns across TikTok, Meta, and leading DSPs, including Connected TV, to maximize reach and engagement.

  • Real-Time Optimization: Adjusted targeting and creatives dynamically to drive purchases and lower acquisition costs.

​​

Results

  • Subscriber Growth: Delivered 2,500 new yearly subscribers monthly.

  • High-Value Users: Focused on U.S. audiences, achieving sustained revenue growth.

  • Performance Excellence: Exceeded client KPIs with efficient CPA and scalable campaigns.

  • Cross-Platform Success: Leveraged TikTok and Meta as primary acquisition channels, supported by DSPs and CTV.
